name: Insert the pattern and the pattern manager.

pages.text: You have three ways to store and retrieve patterns:$(br)-Click this button in the Pattern Terminal, and the written pattern will be sent to the Pattern Bus$(br)-At the controller, click the button to enter the Pattern Manager, and drag the pattern into the result box$(br)-Manually place it into the Pattern Bus
The Pattern Manager can also search for corresponding patterns based on ingredients and products.
